ToneOptions.Label: Strategic Visionary
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Forward-looking and confident, emphasizing long-term benefits and competitive advantage.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven Pragmatic
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Objective and analytical, focusing on metrics, facts, and practical implementation.

ToneOptions.Label: Urgent & Decisive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Direct and action-oriented, highlighting immediate needs and clear next steps.

ToneOptions.Label: Collaborative & Balanced
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Inclusive and comprehensive, acknowledging challenges while proposing solutions.

GoalOptions.Label: Secure Investment
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to secure the necessary investment and executive approval to initiate the proposed cloud migration and scalability project. This document should clearly articulate the ROI and strategic imperative for enhancing our customer landing page infrastructure.

GoalOptions.Label: Align Technical Strategy
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to align the Board and VP Engineering on the critical technical strategy for re-architecting our customer landing page. It should demonstrate how the proposed solution addresses current capacity issues and positions us for future growth and innovation.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Risk
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to highlight the critical risks associated with the current landing page infrastructure and present a robust solution for mitigation. This includes ensuring business continuity, preventing revenue loss due to downtime, and protecting brand reputation.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Performance
GoalOptions.Text: The goal is to present a clear path to achieving superior performance for our customer landing page, specifically targeting 99.99% availability and sub-200ms page load times. This document should justify the technical approach for elastic scalability and enhanced user experience.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & Strategic Impact
Criteria: Project secures full funding and executive sponsorship within 30 days.
Demonstrable ROI presented, showing projected cost savings or revenue uplift.
Solution aligns with company's 3-year digital transformation roadmap.
Mitigation of reputational risk due to current capacity limitations is clearly articulated.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Operational Readiness
Criteria: Proposed architecture demonstrably meets 99.99% availability target.
Solution design ensures sub-200ms page load latency under peak load.
Scalability plan effectively handles 5x sudden traffic spikes without degradation.
Deployment strategy includes robust monitoring and incident response protocols.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Resource & Implementation Feasibility
Criteria: Project timeline and resource allocation are deemed realistic and achievable.
Key technical dependencies and potential roadblocks are identified with mitigation plans.
Team skill sets and training requirements for new cloud technologies are addressed.
Clear ownership and accountability for project phases are established.
